purpose: Teach: 高圧/無秩序/慈悲/漂流/召喚/同化/戒め/惨事

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、高圧政策下の市民生活を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Sakura — I see you wrote your paper on civic life under authoritarian rule.
lines.style: Warm, encouraging tone. Slight pause after the name—giving space for recognition. Genuinely curious, not testing. Steady eye contact, the posture of someone who has read the work and wants to hear the student's own thinking.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、無秩序状態下の社会復興を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I focused on social reconstruction in the aftermath of chaos.
lines.style: Careful, thoughtful delivery. Slight pause before explaining—gathering her thoughts, not rushing. Quiet conviction underneath. She's aware this is serious material and treats it that way, but not performatively.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 近代の慈悲を巡る宗教思想を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And your other paper examined religious thought around modern mercy?
lines.style: Softer, more reflective inflection. A real question—not leading. She leans in slightly, inviting Sakura to expand. The tone of someone recognizing intellectual maturity in a student.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、難民船の漂流事案を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes—I wrote about the refugee ship crisis and what it revealed.
lines.style: Measured, matter-of-fact. No lightness here—the subject is heavy and she speaks to that weight without being dramatic. Direct gaze. She's not deflecting the seriousness.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 国会の証人召喚史を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: I notice you also wrote on the history of witness testimony in the Diet.
lines.style: Alert, genuinely interested inflection. She's tracking a pattern across Sakura's choices. Leans forward slightly—this observation matters to her. Conversational but attentive.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、少数民族の同化政策を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I explored assimilation policies toward ethnic minorities.
lines.style: Steady voice, unflinching. She's aware of what she's chosen to study. No apology in her tone, but also no bravado. Clean delivery—she trusts the topic to speak for itself.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 戦時下の戒めの言説を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Your final piece was on wartime discourse and moral caution?
lines.style: Gentle, almost wondering. She's moved by the arc of these choices. Pace is slightly slower—giving the question weight. The tone of an adult recognizing something in a young person.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、近代の海上惨事を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes—I wrote about maritime disasters in the modern era and their aftermath.
lines.style: Quiet, sure. The final answer. She's drawn a line under these papers. No trailing-off, but a sense of completion. She meets Asuka's eye. She knows what she's chosen and why.
